cards.card_text: Then God gives Moses a formula for incense: gum resin, onycha, galbanum and pure frankincense in equal measures, blended by a perfumer and seasoned with salt.
cards.verse_text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures, and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
cards.snippet: …measures, and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

cards.card_text: He also makes the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
cards.verse_text: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
cards.snippet: …sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.

cards.card_text: Perfumers and cooks and bakers Weavers and potters and shepherds Singers and dancers and musicians
cards.verse_text: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
cards.snippet: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.

cards.card_text: The crews include goldsmiths and perfumers, and Shallum, a ruler in Jerusalem, works with the help of his daughters.
cards.verse_text: And next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs.
cards.snippet: And next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs.
